title: High-temperature physical properties of tungsten: implications for near-field thermophotovoltaic energy conversion
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7011-7021
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10049F, Paper
Open Access

Tran Dinh Cuong, Anh D. Phan
A new theoretical scheme is developed to clarify how tungsten emitters expand, deform, resist electric currents, and interact with electromagnetic waves in near-field thermophotovoltaic devices.
